{{Quote|This isn't just the end of Nuso Esva. ''[&hellip;]'' It's also the beginning. The beginning of victory.|Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
An '''attack''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]'s [[Red City]] was carried out by [[Empire of the Hand]] forces under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] [[Core name/Legends|"Thrawn"]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. The goal of the engagement was to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]], an ally of the Red City's inhabitants, the [[Quesoth]], so that [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Nuso Esva's realm|reign]] of terror did not expand across the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] once again. Knowing that Thrawn would devise his strategy according to the warlord's [[Painting/Legends|paintings]], Esva selected certain pieces that the Quesoth [[bowlcarrier]] [[Trevik]] would&mdash;as Esva planned&mdash;share with Thrawn through Imperial [[Stromma Council Liaison]] [[Nyama]], who provided recordings of the commands given to the [[Quesoth Soldier]]s in [[Quesoth Soldier Speak]] by the ruler of the Quesoth, the [[Queen of the Red]].

Thrawn knew of this plot, but did as his opponent expected during the attack on the Red City, sending nine [[juggernaut]]s to the city's [[Setting Sun Avenue]], where the Imperial [[Gray Squadron (Empire of the Hand)|Gray Squadron]] [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] and [[501st Legion (Empire of the Hand)|501st Legion]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] destroyed the Storm-hair [[Planetary shield/Legends|umbrella shields]] protecting the [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] and their [[Weapon/Legends|heavy weaponry]]. Meanwhile, the Chosen and the Soldiers fought off the attackers, eventually breaching the juggernauts under Esva's command. With Nyama's recordings, and Gray Squadron [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel's]] commandeering of one of the Queen's [[Speaker/Legends|loudspeakers]] that shared her commands, the Grand Admiral was able to order the Quesoth warriors to go to the [[Dwelling of Guests]] building, inside which the Red monarch and her ally were directing the battle.

Esva thought the Queen had betrayed him, and shot her in fear before telling Trevik to tell Thrawn that although he was dead, the Chosen would kill the Grand Admiral wherever he tried to hide. While the Quesoth forces ran to the Dwelling and the stormtroopers killed the Chosen, the bowlcarrier did as he was told. Following the death of Esva, Thrawn launched the [[Thrawn campaign]], a campaign to restore the fragmented [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Prelude==
===Clash of the warlords===
{{Quote|When the battle is over and Thrawn has lost, he will leave. ''[&hellip;]'' He'll have no choice. His defeat here by primitives will severely damage the reputation that holds his fragile coalition together, and he and his star caravan will need to travel to other conflicts to take personal charge of those battles. Once he's gone, we'll take our newly captured vehicles to the White City. The Queen of the Red will become the Queen of Quethold&mdash;and I will have free access to the industrial facilities beneath the White City. There I will construct vehicles in which I and my Chosen may leave this world and once again carry the war to my enemies.|Warlord Nuso Esva|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
[[File:ChosenNusoEsva.png|thumb|right|200px|The Chosen, Nuso Esva's warriors]]
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]], a member of the [[Species/Legends|species]] known to the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] species of the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOCQ">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]], the [[Quesoth]], as the [[Storm-hair]]s, [[Nuso Esva's campaign against the Galactic Empire|launched]] a campaign against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The goal of the operation was to draw Esva's archnemesis, [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]]<ref name="Choices">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref> [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]]<ref name="OBF" /> [[Core name/Legends|"Thrawn"]] of the Galactic Empire and [[Empire of the Hand]], to the Imperial [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]], where the<ref name="Choices" /> Storm-hair's<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Eastern Fleet]]&mdash;one of his three [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] of equal strength that formed his [[Nuso Esva's battle fleet|battle fleet]]&mdash;and [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]] elite [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] force would finally destroy the Chiss so that Esva could continue his [[Nuso Esva's conquests|conquests]] and conquer the Galactic Empire. Although Thrawn traveled to Candoras' [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]] and Esva's forces [[Battle of the Poln system|engaged]] the senior captain's, the Galactic Empire's [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], Thrawn's [[Task Force Admonitor]], and elements of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] were able to shatter the warlord's Eastern Fleet and put him on the offensive.<ref name="Choices" />

At some point after the Candoras [[Sector/Legends|sector]] engagement, Esva [[Battle of Oristrom|attacked]] the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> Unknown Regions<ref name="EAOCO">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Oristrom system/Legends|Oristrom system]]</ref> planet [[Oristrom]], homeworld of the [[Stromma]] species. Studying the warlord's artwork, Thrawn was able to gain insight into his strategy and free Oristrom along with the other Stromma worlds, prompting the species to join the Chiss's Empire of the Hand.<ref name="Choices" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Crisis of FaithD" /> the Storm-hair allied himself with the ruler of Quethold's [[Red City]], the [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|ruling]] [[Queen of the Red]], promising her that he would help kill the [[Queen of the White]] that was to succeed her in two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] so the Red monarch would rule forever. In exchange, Esva gained access to the [[Quesoth Soldier]]s, the Queen's loyalty, and would obtain the [[Shipyard/Legends|ship manufacturing]] facilities in the White monarch's [[White City]] which he would use to manufacture [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that he could use to once again bring death to his enemies.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

===Preparations===
{{Quote|I've heard enough. The Stromma council will not risk its warriors in this mad attack. Particularly not an attack against our allies. I hereby withdraw all of them from Imperial service, effective immediately.|Stromma Council Liaison Nyama snaps|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
[[File:Thrawn-DB.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Senior Captain Thrawn]]
Meanwhile, now-[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] Thrawn and an Empire of the Hand [[Unidentified council|council]] including [[Stromma Council Liaison]] [[Nyama]], [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]], [[Stormtrooper Commander]] [[Balkin]], [[Gray Squadron (Empire of the Hand)|Gray Squadron]] [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]], and [[Nyama's conciliator]], prepared for the final battle [[Nuso Esva–Empire of the Hand conflict|against]] Esva aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]''. The Chiss stated that Thrawn's forces had been [[Blockade/Legends|blockading]] Quethold since they learnt Esva was on the planet, but the blockade had to be lifted so that the Grand Admiral could take care of other threats, and Balkin offered that the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the [[501st Legion (Empire of the Hand)|501st Legion]] were ready to eliminate Esva. That statement prompted Nyama to explain the capabilities of the three Quesoth castes&mdash;the [[Circling]], [[Midli]], [[Workers]] and Soldiers&mdash;and mock Thrawn's plan for the attack: destroy the [[Planetary shield/Legends|umbrella shields]] that protected the Red City with [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]] and destroy the Chosen's heavy [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]] with Balkin's stormtroopers.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

Considering such a strategy mad, Nyama withdrew all Stromma personnel from Imperial service, but not before translating several of the Queen of the Red's commands to the Soldiers in [[Quesoth Soldier Speak]]. The liaison also suggested tasking a disaffected Midli with recording the paintings Esva had brought to his residence in the Red City, the [[Dwelling of Guests]] building, making arrangements for that. In truth, Nyama was an agent of the Storm-hairs, and had suggested such a thing to manipulate Thrawn's strategy by sharing the paintings Esva had selected to confuse Thrawn. Midli [[bowlcarrier]] [[Trevik]] received that task from his [[Trevik's family|family]] [[Jirvin]], and carried it out in hopes of proving to his brother that the Queen of the Red was a willing ally of her warlord ally. The Grand Admiral knew of the plot, but followed it nonetheless, sending his stormtroopers on [[A-rack]] vehicles behind nine [[juggernaut]]s to the Quesoth city's [[Setting Sun Avenue]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==The attack==
===Outsmarting Nuso Esva===
{{Quote|Because the area won't be guarded solely by Quesoth Soldiers. He'll also have a number of heavy-weapons emplacements concealed along the route, waiting for our juggernauts. As our forces enter the city, he'll angle the umbrella shields downward along the route, protecting the shields' generators from the juggernauts' fire, as well as preventing the tanks from straying off that path. Once the juggernauts have penetrated a predetermined distance into the city, he'll blast the first and last ones in line, thereby trapping all the others. At that point, he can destroy them at his leisure. ''[&hellip;]''<s></s>''"<br />"''So how do we counter it? ''[&hellip;]'' We first let him think his plan is working. ''[&hellip;]'' That means sending the line of juggernauts in as he expects. ''[&hellip;]'' But before he can launch his attack, we destroy the trap.|Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo and Senior Captain Voss Parck|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
Thrawn's seven [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and nine empty juggernauts then landed on the city. Fel's Gray Squadron flew over the Red City, looking for holes in the umbrella shields through which his squadron could attack. As Gray Squadron flew over [[Juggernaut One]], Esva's [[Stromma cannon|cannons]] opened fire while a hundred Quesoth Soldiers left their Worker homes and attacked the stormtroopers from behind. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tasse]] reported that the Storm-hair forces had hit Juggernaut One nearly as hard as they had hit Nine while two thousand Quesoth attacked the juggernauts. The stormtroopers hid within three Worker residences located near a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] in hopes of destroying it, and drove back the attackers with an [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]] operated by stormtroopers [[Shrinks]], [[Lhagva]], [[Bragger]], and [[Line Lieutenant]] [[Dramos Sanjin]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

Two thousand more Quesoth revealed themselves and moved in on the juggernauts along with several members of the Chosen, with another fifteen hundred Soldiers sieging the vehicles. Two shield projectors were destroyed shortly afterward, and Thrawn commanded his stormtroopers forces to continue their attack on the shield generator they were trying to destroy as part of Esva's script. However, the fourteenth Quesoth loudspeaker was located, and Fel was ordered to attack. The Chosen hit his left wing, which in fact was fake, and Fel continued to "crash" while<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Kres'ten'tarthi]]<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> continued his siege on the laser cannons. Ejecting his wings and firing at several homes, the baron destroyed all loudspeakers but one, which Thrawn used to order the Soldiers to go to the Dwelling and protect Esva.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

===Capture of the Red City===
{{Quote|Perhaps it is you who are the traitor, Nuso Esva of the First of the Storm-hairs. You promised us victory. You promised me eternal life. You have broken faith on both.''"<br />"''You wish eternal life? ''[&hellip;]'' Then go to the juggernauts and order your Soldiers to attack the transports. ''[&hellip;]''<s></s>''"<br />"''No. ''[&hellip;]''<s></s>''"<br />"''Give your Workers the order. ''[&hellip;]'' Or die.|The Queen of the Red and Warlord Nuso Esva|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
[[File:VossParck.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Senior Captain Voss Parck served under Grand Admiral Thrawn during the attack.]]
Realizing that the juggernauts were useless, Esva ordered his Quesoth ally into battle, where she would order her Soldiers to the Imperial transports. The monarch believed the Storm-hair wanted to go to the transports to flee Quethold with his Chosen and refused, as did Trevik. In fury, the warlord grabbed his blaster and threatened the Queen to cooperate if she wished to live; however, she did not, and died along with Circling [[Borosiv]] and several Workers. Ordering the late monarch's bowlcarrier to tell Thrawn that although Esva was dead, the warlord's followers were far more numerous than the Grand Admiral could imagine and would find the Chiss, and kill him, the Storm-hair leader accepted his fate. The remaining Chosen fired, the stormtroopers killed them, the Soldiers entered the Dwelling, and the Imperial forces murdered Esva.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|You're going to take a message to Thrawn for me. Tell Thrawn that he may think he's won. But with my death, his own will not be far off. My followers are still out there, and they're more numerous than he can possibly imagine. No matter where he goes, no matter where he tries to hide, they will find him. You'll tell him that.|Warlord Nuso Esva tasks bowlcarrier Trevik with delivering a message to Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
In the aftermath of the attack&mdash;during which a stormtrooper died&mdash;on the Red City, Thrawn told Parck that one of the corpses within the Dwelling had been identified as Esva's and that after hearing Trevik's message, a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] had been assigned to serve him,<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Rukh/Legends|Rukh]].<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> The Grand Admiral also commanded the senior captain to travel to the [[Chaos Triangle]], a location where the ''Admonitor'', under Pack's command, would cleanup Esva's legacy. While the Chaos Triangle was cleansed, Thrawn began what he referred to as "victory," [[Thrawn campaign|rebuilding]] the Galactic Empire.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack debuted in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', published in [[2011]] as part of the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of Zahn's [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
